v.t: Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;

tm.apostle: Letter written by Peter, an apostle (1 Pet 1:1).

v.t: That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Peter, an apostle (1 Pet 1:1).

v.t: For the time past of our life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, and abominable idolatries:

tm.apostle: Letter written by Peter, an apostle (1 Pet 1:1).

v.t: Wherein they think it strange that ye run not with them to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:

tm.apostle: Letter written by Peter, an apostle (1 Pet 1:1).

v.t: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Peter, an apostle (1 Pet 1:1).

v.t: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Peter, an apostle (1 Pet 1:1).

v.t: But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Peter, an apostle (1 Pet 1:1).

v.t: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Peter, an apostle (1 Pet 1:1).
tm.ot: Is strongly linked by readers to Prov 10:12 (68 reader votes, OpenBible.info).

v.t: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Peter, an apostle (1 Pet 1:1).

v.t: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Peter, an apostle (1 Pet 1:1).

v.t: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Peter, an apostle (1 Pet 1:1).

v.t: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:

tm.apostle: Letter written by Peter, an apostle (1 Pet 1:1).

v.t: But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ’s sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Peter, an apostle (1 Pet 1:1).

v.t: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are ye; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Peter, an apostle (1 Pet 1:1).

v.t: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men’s matters.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Peter, an apostle (1 Pet 1:1).

v.t: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Peter, an apostle (1 Pet 1:1).

v.t: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God?

tm.apostle: Letter written by Peter, an apostle (1 Pet 1:1).

v.t: And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?

tm.apostle: Letter written by Peter, an apostle (1 Pet 1:1).
tm.ot: Is strongly linked by readers to Prov 11:31 (44 reader votes, OpenBible.info).

v.t: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Peter, an apostle (1 Pet 1:1).
